name: local-chatter
description: React + Hono app for monitoring CNC machine status

scripts.dev:history: mkdir -p apps/server/data/alert-rules && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d
scripts.build: npm run build -w @local-chatter/shared && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @local-chatter/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && tsc -p tools/fake-machines
scripts.test: npm run test:run -w @local-chatter/shared && npm run test:run -w apps/web && npm run test:run -w apps/server && npm run test:tools
